text: At 5 AM, a whole country switched road sides.
say: At five A M, a whole country switched road sides.

text: Swedes drive on the left. Every neighbour drives on the right.
say: Swedes drive on the left. Every neighbour drives on the right.

text: In a vote, 83% of Swedes said: keep the left.
say: In a vote, eighty-three percent of Swedes said: keep the left.

text: Sunday, September 3rd. At 4:50, every car in the country stops.
say: Sunday, September third. At four fifty, every car in the country stops.

text: Wait... how do you change sides?
say: Wait... how do you change sides?

text: You see, you just... carefully drive across.
say: You see, you just... carefully drive across.

text: About 350,000 road signs had to be swapped.
say: About three hundred and fifty thousand road signs had to be swapped.
